display_name: Google Shopping API - Product Search, Merchant Offers, Prices
summary: Google Shopping product and price data as structured JSON: search products with min/max price, on-sale, free-shipping and price-sort filters returning title, price, seller, rating and reviews, open a full product page with specs and variants, then page every store selling it. 3 endpoints, 1 credit each.
